title: oscore patch dep per-host symlink wiring (rust/oscore-fork + link script)
description: Child of xyt6 (1/2): make [patch.crates-io] oscore path work on any host. Committed /Volumes path breaks Linux workers (no sudo); /home/mark repoint breaks Mac. Wire Cargo.toml patch path to a relative gitignored symlink rust/oscore-fork, created per host by rust/scripts/link-oscore-fork.sh (candidates: ~/crates/oscore, /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore; clear error if none). Acceptance: cargo metadata + cargo check -p lichen-node succeed on this Linux host from the committed tree state with no /Volumes or /home/mark absolute path in rust/Cargo.toml. Note: Mac/Linux forks differ in version (0.1.0 vs 0.1.2) -> Cargo.lock churn is expected until forks are reconciled (beads trsk/l0ij).
